['Select molecule_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'Join activities ON activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', 'Join assays ON assays.assay_id = activities.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary ON target_dictionary.tid = assays.tid', 'Join compound_structures ON compound_structures.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno', "Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'", "Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1824'", "Filter activities.type = 'IC50'", 'Return molecule_chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles', 'Distinct', 'Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles']
